osg1.line: The independent review of how our build sandboxes are isolated (OSG-1) is OPEN. Until it is closed, no customer data goes anywhere near it.

states.BUILT_TESTED: Built, and an automated test passes against it. Synthetic data only. Not independently reviewed.
states.PLANNED: Designed on paper. Not built yet.
states.OPEN: Not yet evidenced, or waiting on an independent review.

claims.claim: Each piece of evidence names its owner, its scope, a review date and a hash of the file it describes. Evidence past its review date shows as expired.
Every connection in the Trust Passport is checked as read-only, and a write scope is rejected.

evidence.detail: bin/ent_trust.py scope test, covered by bin/test_ent_trust.sh. The check is a word pattern, not a live probe of a provider.

claims.claim: Changes that matter (activation, wider permissions) need a named person to approve them. A system cannot approve its own work, and production activation is blocked while OSG-1 is open.

evidence.detail: approval contracts in bin/ent_trust.py, covered by bin/test_ent_trust.sh. No identity provider sits behind approvals yet.

claims.claim: Security questionnaire answers quote the evidence on file word for word. Where there is no evidence, the answer says UNKNOWN or OPEN.

evidence.detail: 25-question questionnaire in bin/ent_trust.py, covered by bin/test_ent_trust.sh

claims.claim: Every demonstration dataset is labelled SYNTHETIC. No customer data is used in a demo.

evidence.detail: fixtures under docs/enterprise/e3_trust carry the SYNTHETIC label, checked by bin/ent_trust.py lint and covered by bin/test_ent_trust.sh

claims.claim: The free first reading uses public DNS and public pages only, and never asks for a login.

evidence.anchor: public DNS and public pages only
evidence.detail: Stated on the security page. No separate automated test of the scan behaviour is attached to this page yet.

claims.claim: Quote files sent for a free audit are deleted after 30 days, or the same day on request.

evidence.anchor: 30 days from when you send it
evidence.detail: A published promise. Deletion is not yet covered by an automated test or an independent check.

claims.claim: Build sandboxes and customer environments are isolated from each other.

evidence.detail: This is the OSG-1 review. It is OPEN, so we make no isolation claim.

claims.claim: An independent security assessment or penetration test of the platform.

evidence.detail: None has been done. Nothing on this page stands in for one.

claims.claim: A private Trust Centre for each customer, showing their own connections, retention and open issues.

evidence.detail: Design only. This public page is the evidence-state format that portal would follow.

claims.claim: Read-only connectors that a customer can revoke in one step.

evidence.detail: Design only. No connector exists, and none will touch real data before OSG-1 is closed and an independent review is done.
